title: Core tests take ids from the mint
objective: Every test in intentsvcs and intentd takes a thread, work package or issue id from what the mint returned, so no test predicts the next number.
body:
Seat: cc. Size: S.

## Scope

- The facade's `st_new` already returns the id. `wp_new` and `issue_add` return a number today (`facade.rs:16174`, `19266`). Bind the return value at each site that today names the id it expects.
- dc's census classes P and H for these two crates (dc's census, section 4, banked under `refs/bank/dc/st0095/`). Class H is read one by one: a helper that mints, or a record a fixture seeded.
- A record a fixture seeded keeps its literal. That is class N, and it stays valid.

## Out of scope

- The tests whose subject is the ordinal scheme (`facade_st_wp.rs:22`, `:52`, `:91-92`, and the renumber and taken-id tests). They are rewritten with the scheme, in WP-06.
- intent-cli's tests (WP-02) and the shell (WP-03).

## Order

First, beside WP-02 and WP-03. Behaviour-neutral: it lands green on today's ordinals.

## Proof

The cut's own gate. dc's predict census over the two crates reads no site.
